headline: OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program Puts AI at the Heart of Energy Security
summary: OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program is leveraging AI to ensure the stability and reliability of the power grid, marking a significant step in integrating AI into critical infrastructure. This initiative is gaining attention for its potential to transform energy security.
whyItMatters: It highlights the growing role of AI in critical infrastructure and could set a precedent for future AI applications in essential services.
